name: Vampire - Bite (Costs 2 Actions) - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a legendary

results.text: Fangs pierce flesh like daggers through velvet, a surge of life flooding the undead conqueror's veins.
With a savage twist, the vampire tears into his victim's neck, savoring their final screams.
Blood sprays hot and thick as the legendary predator claims another soul for eternity.
The night's symphony crescendos with the wet crunch of bone beneath the vampire's merciless bite.
A gush of scarlet cascades down pale cheeks, fueling the undead horror's dark power.
